{{Top|leg}}
The '''''Hold 'Em''''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[CC-7700/E interdiction cruiser]] in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Rapid Response Task Force]], commanded by a [[Unidentified Hold 'Em's captain|captain]].<ref name="Shadows of Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the ''Hold 'Em'' participated in the [[Battle of Mindor]], where it was destroyed when it was hit by a [[gravity bomb]]. The resulting explosion broke the ship in half.<ref name="Shadows of Mindor" />
